author: Vikas Shivpuriya <vikas.ny30@gmail.com>
description: Deterministic output-side guard for model responses. Checks what a model said before it reaches the user across the output-side Aletheia signatures (S1, S2a, S3-output, S4, S5, S6, S7) in sub-millisecond time with no LLM in the hot path by default (an optional model judge runs with your own API key), and scores itself against a bundled labeled eval set. A first-line pre-filter, not a guarantee.
displayName: Aletheia Aegis Output Guard & Eval Harness
name: aletheia-aegis
